collection: When field performance monitoring is on, this site samples 10% of browser documents and sends performance measurements to the site’s own Event Runner function. The application payload has only a metric name and value, a categorical route pattern, and a mobile or desktop viewport class. The function stores Core Web Vitals and counts of waits that show the site’s taking-longer message only in anonymous daily aggregate value buckets. The application payload and aggregate store do not contain full page URLs, page-element selectors, account identifiers, cookie identifiers, session identifiers, IP addresses, or IP address hashes. Standard platform HTTP request logs are separate from these aggregates and are unchanged. The measurements use no third-party analytics endpoint.
retention: When field performance monitoring is on, each anonymous daily aggregate expires 30 days after the start of its UTC day. An observation is therefore scheduled to expire after 29 to 30 days. Cleanup runs every 30 minutes, so an expired aggregate can remain until the next cleanup.
